We recently took our one-year-old pup, Pluto, to Scenthound for the first time, and my husband and I could not be more grateful for the experience we had. From the moment we walked in, the entire team made us feel welcomed, supported, and completely comfortable leaving Pluto in their care.
Jenny, Leslie, Destiny, Cyleste, and Kristal were all incredibly sweet, patient, and accommodating. Since Pluto is newly with our family and this was his first grooming visit with us, we had quite a few questions and a bit of nervousness. Each of them took the time to walk us through exactly what his first visit would entail, explaining every step clearly and making sure we understood all of our options.
What we appreciated most was how understanding and compassionate they were about our situation. At no point did we feel pressured into anything—they simply focused on what would be best for Pluto and what we were comfortable with. Their kindness and genuine care for him were so evident, and it gave us so much peace of mind.
When we picked Pluto up, it was obvious that he had been treated with patience and care. By the end of the visit, we felt completely confident that he was in wonderful hands.
We’re so thankful for the exceptional service from the entire team, and we absolutely plan on bringing Pluto back every month. I would wholeheartedly recommend Scenthound to anyone looking for a grooming team that truly cares about both pets and their owners.

We have been members of Scenthound Meyerland location since its opening. I have not previously had any problems with them. On November 29, my dog had an 815 appointment for a bath. Despite prior reminders, I failed to remember the appointment. I received a phone call from them at 8:22 Letting me know that I missed the appointment. Since I have a membership, I am charged monthly For his bath, whether I am there or not. I let them know that I would just forfeit this month since I missed the appointment. At that point, they told me that I would be charged 50% Extra due to the missed appointment Regardless, if I rescheduled or not. The 50% was apparently 50% of the regular prices and not 50% of the membership prices Which was an extra $84. I asked why I was being charged extra if I was going to forfeit the appointment and was told that the groomers had to clock out if the appointment was a no-show. I don’t quite understand this since I had already paid for the service.
I have never missed a prior appointment. On at least two occasions, they have canceled the appointment either for staffing issues or for power outages. My only option on either one of the Cancellations from their end was to reschedule.
I had asked them what the process was for cancellation. They indicated the manager would call me. She never did. I canceled on the app, which also indicated that I would receive a phone call, but again did not.
Again, I take full responsibility for missing the appointment, but at most I should forfeit the cost of the service that I missed.

This place is awesome! My roommate started taking a foster dog she's caring for here. The dog had massive skin problems with big patches of missing hair and scaley skin. She also had horribly dirty ears from repeated ear infections and we believed her to be completely deaf. After one bath a week for 6 or 7 weeks her skin has cleared up and her coat looks amazing. Her bare spots are filling in as well. I should also mention that she is not good with strangers and has been known to nip and they not only took her but won her over in a single visit. My roommate asked them to use prescription shampoo and ear wash and they were happy to do so.
I'd also like to point out this location provides free bathing to dogs who find themselves at the nearby Bellaire pound. Staff couldn't be nicer to canines and people. Oh also the dogs hearing came back partialy as well from the thorough ear cleaning.
